---
title: "AIR: Australian Immunisation Register"
description: "Information about vaccinations provided to people, as recorded in the Australian Immunisation Register."
---

Information about vaccinations provided to people, as recorded in the Australian Immunisation Register.

*Defines AIR coverage, vaccination information, reporting requirements and uses.*
